description: Published aggregate ranges for context only. These values are not per-dune labels and must not be used as training targets for individual dunes.

measurements.citation: Boazman et al., Measuring Ripple and Dune Migration in Coprates Chasma, Valles Marineris: A Source to Sink Aeolian System on Mars?, JGR Planets, 2021.
limitations: The range aggregates observations across the study area.
It is not a label for any individual polygon in the shapefile.
The acquisition interval must still be verified before a local rate is computed.
measurements.notes: Reported brink migration range; do not assign it to individual dunes.

measurements.citation: Davis et al., Quantified Aeolian Dune Changes on Mars Derived From Repeat Context Camera Images, Earth and Space Science, 2020.
measurements.temporal_scope: approximately 7.5-11 Earth years depending on site
limitations: The range aggregates six separate dune fields.
It is not a label for individual dunes.
Site-specific baselines differ and must be resolved independently.
measurements.notes: Published aggregate migration range for the repeat-CTX study.

measurements.citation: Davis et al., Quantified Aeolian Dune Changes on Mars Derived From Repeat Context Camera Images, Earth and Space Science, 2020.
measurements.unit: m^3 per m per Earth year
measurements.temporal_scope: approximately 7.5-11 Earth years depending on site
limitations: Flux is not migration rate and the two must not be interchanged.

measurements.notes: Published aggregate flux range; keep separate from displacement metrics.

measurements.citation: Sahu et al., regional study reporting Pasteur crater ripple-crest rates.
limitations: Pasteur crater is not Jezero Crater.
These values must not be transferred to Jezero or used as Jezero labels.
Interior dune migration at Jezero is reported to be limited.
measurements.notes: Included only to prevent unsupported transfer to Jezero.
